guide:
Trailhead Shoes: agent interface
This store sells 6 products (5 running, 1 hiking), in sizes 7–10.
Use the bash tool to run shop commands. Pipes and jq work.

Commands
  shop search [--color C] [--category C] [--min-price N] [--max-price N] [--size N] [--in-stock] [words...] [--json] [--limit N]
      find variants matching every filter; prints a count and near misses
  shop product <slug-or-SKU>    one product with every size, SKU and live stock
  shop cart add <SKU>           add one item; prints the full cart
  shop cart show                show the cart
  shop checkout --dry-run       preview an order (orders are never placed here)

Example
$ shop search --color white --size 9 --in-stock
1 match (showing 1)
AER-WHT-09	Aero Pace	white	running	$79	size 9	stock 2
Near misses:
  Tempo Lite: color is black, not white
  Cloud Glide: color is navy, not white
  Summit Hiker: color is black, not white
